title: asimap delivery spool entry
description: A message dropped in a user's .asimap-spool directory for asimap to deliver. Written as <id>-incoming.json and renamed to <id>-ready.json when complete.

id.description: Lowercase uuid7. Must match the file name stem.

received_at.description: When the message was received, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset. Becomes the message's internal date.

source.description: Name of the producer, for logging.

deliveries.description: Where to deliver the message. Missing or empty means the inbox.

message.description: The raw RFC 5322 message bytes, base64 encoded.

folder.description: MH folder relative to the mail store root. No empty, '.', '..', or dot-prefixed components. 'inbox' is case-insensitive. Defaults to 'inbox'.

flags.description: IMAP flags to set. Without '\Seen' the message is unseen.

create.description: Create the folder if missing. When false, a missing folder means delivery to the inbox.
